```{r knitr_options, include = FALSE}
library(knitr)
opts_chunk$set(comment = "")
```

```{r, Libraries}
suppressMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(rstudioapi)
})
```


```{r, Background Launcher, eval = FALSE}
# START HERE: run this chunk every time you are ready to run full pipeline or just specific parts. This chunk is like a launcher for the master pipeline. It saves this file and knits it as a background job, so every stage below runs one after another in the background. Each part of the master pipeline is set in stages (my different starting .Rmd files, which are now all connected to this .Rmd), so before running check which stages you want to run with TRUE or FALSE. Previous .rmd specific editable variable are now shared if possible, so every stage uses the same parameters, if there are specific settings for each stages, check those manually in the chunks below.
# All paths are written from the project folder (Full_workflow).

#Paths
master_rmd_path <- getSourceEditorContext()$path #grabs the path of the current tab in source editor, when you click run it finds this path
project_folder <- if (is.null(getActiveProject())) dirname(master_rmd_path) else getActiveProject() # Full_workflow, found automatically from R project
documentSave(getSourceEditorContext()$id) #writes and saves tab before rendering, id is the internal id of the tab. background job reads it from a disk
dir.create(file.path(project_folder, "Code/HTMLs"), showWarnings = FALSE) #folder for htmls
master_job_script <- tempfile(fileext = ".R") #gives the name for a temporary file in R temporary folder

#writing HTMLs  
writeLines(sprintf('rmarkdown::render("%s", output_dir = "%s", knit_root_dir = "%s", envir = new.env(), quiet = FALSE)',
  master_rmd_path, file.path(project_folder, "Code/HTMLs"), project_folder), master_job_script) #renders the htmls inside the html folder for every stage

#Launching
jobRunScript(master_job_script, workingDir = project_folder, importEnv = FALSE) #background job starts inside the Full_workflow so all paths are correct, rendering start completely clean with no current session objects, runs the temporary file created before. its skips the launcher chunk (eval=F) and each runs_stage() starts processing a stage
```


```{r, Library dependencies}
# packages the stages need, checked before any stage starts so a missing one fails immediately
required_packages <- c("ggplot2", "patchwork", "dplyr", "tidyverse","readr", "jsonlite", "scales", "readxl", "Biostrings", "pwalign", "parallel", "rstan", "lme4", "grid")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) stop("Install these packages first: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
```


```{r setup}
# Here you can choose which stages to run: TRUE = run, FALSE = skip (if you dont want to run obimultiplexing again for example)
run_01_demultiplexing <- FALSE
run_02_obitools_summaries <- FALSE
run_03_minimap2 <- FALSE
run_04_genotyping <- FALSE
run_05_bayesian <-TRUE
run_06_visualization <- FALSE
run_07_failed_genotypes <- FALSE

# Knits one stage Rmd with its settings in a fresh R process (Rscript), prints the progress in the Background Jobs pane, stops the pipeline if the stage fails, and returns how long it took.
run_stage <- function(stage_rmd, stage_settings = list(), run) { #takes which rmd to run, its settings and whether to run it or not
  if (!run) {
    message("SKIPPED: ", stage_rmd) #skips all FALSE stages
    return(NULL)
  }
  stage_settings_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds") #creates a temporary .rds file with stage settings (you have to pass it as text)
  saveRDS(stage_settings, stage_settings_file)
  
  stage_start <- Sys.time() #timings and banners
  message("STARTED: ", stage_rmd, " at ", format(stage_start, "%H:%M"))
  
  #runs a specific Rscript render_stage.R and tells which .Rmd with which settings to run. the Rscript keeps only the settings the YAML header for each stage needs and knits it to HTML (exits with failed (1) or success (0)).
  stage_exit_status <- system2(file.path(R.home("bin"), "Rscript"), 
    c("Code/R_scripts/render_stage.R", shQuote(stage_rmd), shQuote(stage_settings_file)),
    stdout = "", stderr = "") #sends output to the pane
  
  if (stage_exit_status != 0) stop("Stage failed: ", stage_rmd, " (see the output above)") #if exit status is not 0 it stops every later stage
  stage_minutes <- round(as.numeric(Sys.time() - stage_start, units = "mins"), 1)
  message("FINISHED: ", stage_rmd, " in ", stage_minutes, " min")
  data.frame(stage = basename(stage_rmd), minutes = stage_minutes)
}
```

## Shared settings

Used by several stages, set once here. Each stage only takes the ones it needs.

```{r, Shared Settings} 
#list of shared settings, each stage has two lists glued, this shared on and its own settings. Combined settings list is saved into .rds by the run_stage() which then the render_stage.R uses. All the unused settings by YAML header are dropped, kept settings are sent to render as params and overwrite those in the YAML header. Then inside each stage .Rmd list2env() unpacks that params list.

shared_settings <- list(
  # Dataset
  dataset_name = "big", # small or big, this also affects output directories
  n_barcodes = 24, # 6 for the small dataset, 24 for the big dataset

  # Tools: paths to the installed bin directories on this computer
  dorado_bin_folder = "",
  obitools_bin_folder = "",
  minimap2_bin_folder = "",
  samtools_bin_folder = "",

  # Shared input files, paths from the project folder (should be added manually for different projects)
  barcode_map_path = "Data/Supporting_data/Samples_ONT_barcodes.tsv",
  primer_panel_path = "Data/Supporting_data/Primer_panels/12864_2021_7761_MOESM12_ESM_filtered.xlsx",
  reference_path = "Data/Supporting_data/Genome_reference_data/snps_500bp_sequences.fa", # 1000 bp widened SNP reference genome

  # Genotype calling, the same thresholds for Minimap2 and ASP genotyping
  minimum_required_depth = 3, # minimum reads per sample x SNP to call a genotype
  HT_min_frequence = 0.20, # minor allele fraction needed for HT
  min_snp_quality = 10, # reads whose SNP base is below this Phred quality do not vote (ASP) / are not counted (Minimap2 mpileup -Q), 0 switches it off
  
  # ASP run settings, shared by ASP genotyping and Bayesian genotyping (they make up the ASP results folder name)
  n_cores = 4, # cores for ASP scoring, Stan chains and downsampling
  input_type = "unpadded", # "padded" or "unpadded"
  use_anchors = TRUE, # FALSE for no anchors (I get better results with anchors, minimizes alignment hopping)
  anchor_length = 3, # 1 to 5 reference bases after the SNP
  probe_type = "asp_primers", # "asp_primers" or "reference" (reference needs input_type = "padded")
  threshold_type = "errors", # naive "fraction" or updated "errors" with more settings
  min_score_fraction = 0.65, # for "fraction" only, sets a threshold which is 0.65 * (perfect score of a primer alignment)
  error_rate = 0.08, # for "errors" only, ~1 mismatch per 12.5 bases

  # Strand check, shared by ASP genotyping and Bayesian genotyping
  strand_flag_prob = 0.01, # strand check, a minor allele direction needs at least 8 reads on before it is flagged (strand bias flag)
  expected_minor_fraction = 0.44, # derived from first results
  strand_downgrade = FALSE # TRUE = flagged HT becomes HM, better to just flag first and then manually filter those if needed
)
```

## Stage 1: Dorado demultiplexing and obimultiplex

```{r, Settings_01}
# builds a second list of stage specific settings, they get merged and saved to.rds per stage.
settings_01_demultiplexing <- list(
  # Dorado demux
  run_dorado = TRUE, # FALSE skips dorado when its demultiplexed files already exist
  kit_name = "SQK-NBD114-24", # Nanopore barcoding kit

  # MANUAL FILE PREPARATION: NGSfilter file for obimultiplex, path from the project folder
  ngsfilter_path = "Data/Supporting_data/NGSfilter_file/ngsfilter.csv"
)
```

```{r, Stage_01}
timing_stage_01 <- run_stage("Code/Rmd_Stages/01_Dorado_Demultiplexing_and_Obi4_visualization.Rmd",
  c(shared_settings, settings_01_demultiplexing), run = run_01_demultiplexing)
```

## Stage 2: ObiTools4 summaries and plots

Stage 2 has no settings of its own, it only uses the shared settings.

```{r, Stage_02}
timing_stage_02 <- run_stage("Code/Rmd_Stages/02_ObiTools4_Basic_Visualisation.Rmd",
  shared_settings, run = run_02_obitools_summaries)
```

## Stage 3: Minimap2 genotyping

```{r, Settings_03}
settings_03_minimap2 <- list(
  pad = 50, # bp of extra context restored on each side
  snp_position = 500, # fixed SNP position within every 1000bp reference
  minimum_mapping_quality_threshold = 20 # minimum mapping quality for a read to count toward a genotype call
)
```

```{r, Stage_03}
timing_stage_03 <- run_stage("Code/Rmd_Stages/03_SNP_Genotyping_Minimap2.Rmd",
  c(shared_settings, settings_03_minimap2), run = run_03_minimap2)
```


## Stage 4: ASP genotyping

```{r, Settings_04}
settings_04_genotyping <- list(
  # Alignment
  primer_quality = 19, # Phred quality of every primer base
  gap_opening = 6, # gap opening cost
  gap_extension = 2, # gap extension cost

  # Threshold
  min_errors = 1, # "errors" only, minimum errors allowed per primer

  # Read voting filters
  max_mismatches = 2 # Inf switches it off
)
```

```{r, Stage_04}
timing_stage_04 <- run_stage("Code/Rmd_Stages/04_SNP_Genotyping_ASP_primer.Rmd",
  c(shared_settings, settings_04_genotyping), run = run_04_genotyping)
```


## Stage 5: Bayesian genotyping

```{r, Settings_05}
settings_05_bayesian <- list(
  # What to run
  run_stan = FALSE, # runs Bayes model
  run_downsampling = FALSE, # runs downsampling and calibration statistics (needs run_stan = TRUE in the same run)
  run_stan_plots = TRUE, # runs visualisations (from this run, or from the saved run with the same settings)
  
  # Genotype prior
  prior_type = "ancestry", # "flat" = 1/3 each genotype, "het_share" = one heterozygote share for every pair, "hwe" = locus specific HWE priors from the panel frequencies or ancestry  
  prior_het_share = 0.15, # only used when prior_type == "het_share"
  prior_population = "FreqWOLF_all", # only used when prior_type is set to "hwe": FreqWOLF_all, FreqWOLF_EastEurope, FreqWOLF_IT, FreqWOLF_IB, FreqDOG
  prior_floor = 0.001, # floors allele frequency so no genotype gets an exact-zero prior
  ancestry_prior_shape = 1, # 1 is uniform Beta(1, 1) prior, doesnt assume anything
  phi_hom_structure = "shared", #"shared", "locus", "sample", "locus_sample"
  
  # Stan sampling
  stan_iter = 4000,
  stan_warmup = 1500,
  stan_chains = 4,
  stan_adapt_delta = 0.95,
  max_error = 0.10, # cap on any error rate

  # Downsampling and genotype confidence calibration
  read_depths_to_test = c(3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75),
  draws_per_depth = 300,
  minimum_reads_for_truth_pair = 75,
  bootstrap_rounds = 1000
)
```

```{r, Stage_05}
timing_stage_05 <- run_stage("Code/Rmd_Stages/05_SNP_Bayesian_Genotyping.Rmd",
  c(shared_settings, settings_05_bayesian), run = run_05_bayesian)
```

```{r, Settings_07}

  failed_genotypes_source = "asp_genotypes", # "bayes_genotypes" or "asp_genotypes", which genotype calls are compared with the reference
  failed_max_reads_plotted = 20 # reads drawn per plot, the .tsv table keeps every read
)
```

```{r, Stage_07}
timing_stage_07 <- run_stage("Code/Rmd_Stages/07_Failed_genotypes_analysis.Rmd",
  c(shared_settings, settings_05_bayesian, settings_07_failed_genotypes), run = run_07_failed_genotypes)
```
